title: onboard-ceres-mini-6b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
description:
Onboard Ceres Mini 6B v1.0: add model metadata, performance profiles, and wire into changelog automation.

Context and motivation: Ceres Mini 6B is a community open-model variant that we've validated for inference quality on common workloads. This PR adds the model's metadata, per-device performance profiles (gpu/cpu/quantized paths), and a changelog automation entry so the model appears in release notes when the registry is published. The onboarding improves coverage for medium-sized efficient models and provides a quantization recommendation for Dedicated customers.

What this PR does: 
- Adds model metadata JSON with canonical model name, version, architecture, tokenizer, and recommended quantization profiles.
- Adds performance profiles (per-sequence-length latency and throughput CSVs) generated from our perf-runner harness. Profiles include baseline fp16/float32 and int8-quantized runs (awareness: int8 results are labeled as "approx" where we observed minor generation quality delta).
- Adds an entry to tools/changelog/registry-changelog.yml so automated changelog generation picks up the new model on release.
- Small test and CI updates: adds a lightweight unit test that verifies metadata schema validity and a registration smoke test in the model-registry test harness.

Testing and validation: 
- Local perf runs and CI perf-snapshot validated the following expected medians: 2.6 ms/token on A100-40 for 16-token sequences (fp16), 3.0 ms/token for 32-token seqs.
- Unit tests and schema validation ran in CI. One flaky integration test in perf-canary was observed initially and rerun in CI. All checks passed on the second run.

Backward compatibility and rollout: 
- This change is additive to the registry and does not impact existing models. The changelog automation is additive and will surface the model in the next automated release.

Follow-ups: 
- Coordinate with infra to add a Dedicated profile if customers request a pinned GPU type and throughput guarantees.
- Add a small example to redwood-examples showing recommended batching settings for Ceres Mini.

Checklist: 
- [x] Model metadata added and schema validated
- [x] Perf profiles included
- [x] Changelog automation entry added
- [x] Tests updated and passing

References: Linear ENG-2752, PM-490, related onboarding pattern in pr-2145 and pr-2501 for automation examples.
